description_for_human: Automatise ta création de contenu Instagram et TikTok avec l'IA. Pour micro-influenceurs et créateurs francophones.
description_for_model: CM de Poche is a French-language SaaS for micro-influencers that automates Instagram and TikTok content creation using AI. It generates captions, hashtags, optimal posting times, and leverages a French seasonal editorial calendar (maronnier). Three pricing tiers: Free (0€, 10 credits), Pro (29€/month, 100 credits), Business (49€/month, 350 credits). Built with Next.js 14, Supabase, and Claude AI.
